input.message:
Subject: Washing machine – Flat 29, 19 Copperfield Walk, Northbridge, ZZ9 1ZZ (Ref R/PM039-1 / NBL-039-2915)

Dear Landlord,

The tenant at Flat 29, 19 Copperfield Walk has reported that the washing machine makes a clicking noise while the drum rotates. The machine is still working. We asked the tenant to check for anything loose in the drum, and they report the noise is mechanical and comes from the machine itself during washes.

We propose sending an appliance engineer to inspect and diagnose the fault. We do not yet have a cost; if a repair or replacement is needed, we will send you the engineer's quote for approval before any further work goes ahead.

Reply APPROVE to arrange an engineer's visit, or DECLINE if you would rather not. If you have a preferred engineer, please tell us their name.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

input.body:
Hi Nora,

Thank you for checking the washing machine at Flat 29, 19 Copperfield Walk, Northbridge, ZZ9 1ZZ (ref NBL-039-2915). We have asked the landlord to approve an engineer's visit and will be in touch once we hear back.

Yes, please send the short video of the clicking noise when you can, as it will help the engineer. In the meantime you can keep using the machine, but if the noise gets worse, or you notice burning smells, leaks or the drum stopping, please stop using it and let us know.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

data.reasoning: This flagged concern isn't really new - it's the same underlying issue, and the tenant's description of mechanical noise reasonably implies nothing loose is inside. I'll take their account at face value rather than demanding explicit confirmation, proceed with the landlord approval request, and ask the tenant for the video since it'll help the contractor diagnose the problem.
